chunks: And it was narrated from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr that he said:

I used to observe the stars and know them, and I knew the ascendant, and because of that something would enter into me. So I complained about that to Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them both.
So he said: “If something occurs in your soul, then give charity to the first needy person, then proceed, for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will ward it off from you.”

key_terms.فَتَصَدَّقْ: give charity as a protective act
key_terms.نَفْسِكَ: your inner self where the thought occurs

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if troubling thoughts arise from omens or observing the stars?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that Ibn Abī ʿUmayr was troubled by thoughts connected to observing the stars and mentioned this to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام. The Imam instructed him to give charity to the first needy person and then continue, teaching that sadaqah is a means by which Allah عزّ وجلّ repels harm.
